title: [main] bug 652274 - [CZ] Add the Country/Region of Origin Code field to a document line
summary: Czech Intrastat reporting now supports a Country/Region of Origin Code field on document lines, initialized from the item card but changeable per transaction, with an option to retrieve values from posted entries instead.
key_points: New Country/Reg. of Orig. Code CZ field added to all document, journal, archive, and ledger lines
Field auto-populated from item card but can be manually changed per transaction
New Intrastat Report Setup option to retrieve origin from Item Card (default) or Posted Entries
Value preserved through posting, archiving, direct transfers, and ledger creation
Allows same item from different country sources without requiring separate item cards
quote: The country/region of origin used for Czech Intrastat reporting is currently taken from the item card.
